name: Utah caselaw — Caselaw Access Project
scopeNote: Preserves CAP's Utah jurisdiction assignment: 16,874 Supreme Court records, 6,029 Court of Appeals records under two source court labels, and one historical Salt Lake City Register and Receiver record. Coverage reflects the pinned historical archive, not every decision issued by those courts.
